firstPlayerRule: The last person to return safe and sound from an island is the first player.
clarifications: The first player is chosen before players place Adventurers and Rafts in clockwise order. The game itself also proceeds clockwise.
internalEvidence: The Asmodee Canada product page https://www.asmodee.ca/en/product/survive-the-island/ links this Zygomatic manual. Printed/PDF page 2 directly assigns first player and the subsequent clockwise placement order; page 3 confirms clockwise game turns. Page 2 was rendered and read. The PDF's print date is 27 February 2024. Downloaded source SHA-256: 60e447bd8d8f7d93835e9eb43760c82cdb9648d9321123f1cfed775a59630c0a. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The booklet does not specify a tie-break or a method if nobody has returned from an island.
